race.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: This has the look of an interesting novice and it will probably go to a newcomer, with DEPUTY GENERAL and Highland Ranger arguably the most appealing pair before betting clues. Twice-raced Ring of Music surely has a race like this in him and won't be far away. DEPUTY GENERAL (USA) HIGHLAND RANGER RING OF MUSIC (IRE)
